user.title: Telia Play
user.description: Use the same email (or mobile number) and password as on teliaplay.no. Leave both blank to pair with a TV code instead.

data.include_channels: Also create switches for channel packages

password_fallback.title: Continue with a TV code
password_fallback.description: Telia did not accept {username} and that password ({error}). If the website signs you in with Google or BankID, approve a TV code on your phone — you stay on your own account.

progress.wait_approve:
Code: {code}

On your phone, open {url} while you are already logged in to Telia Play (BankID or Google is fine). This screen continues when you approve.

error.invalid_auth: Could not sign in ({error}). Use the same email or mobile and password as in the browser, or leave them blank and pair with a TV code.
error.no_selection_menu: Signed in, but this account has no Valgmeny / TV points selection. That feature is used on Telia Play Norway.
error.tv_code_expired: The TV code expired or was not approved. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This Telia Play account is already configured.

init.title: Telia Play options
init.description: Optional mailbox: Home Assistant reads Max one-time codes from an inbox you own (not a shared mailbox). Use the same address you type on the Max page, or forward Max mail there. Gmail needs an app password. Home Assistant's IMAP integration is also used automatically.

data.include_channels: Also create switches for channel packages

data_description.imap_username: Leave blank to disable mailbox polling. Existing Home Assistant IMAP events still work.
data_description.imap_password: Leave blank to keep the password already stored.

error.imap_failed: Could not sign in to that mailbox. For Gmail, use an app password and enable IMAP.
error.imap_password_required: Enter the mailbox password (or a Gmail app password).

not_enough_points.message: Not enough included TV points for that selection.
